President Trump on Friday will announce that Medicaid beneficiaries in all 50 states will benefit from "Most Favored Nation" pricing discounts for some prescription drugs.

While Medicaid programs already receive significant discounts from pharmaceutical companies, the White House Council of Economic Advisers projects the move will lead to $27.6B in savings for state governments and $36.6B for the federal government over 10 years, according to
The news website noted that Trump will have a meeting today with the governors of Arkansas, Mississippi, and South Dakota to discuss progress on lowering drug prices.
An AARP Public Policy Institute report released in August found that if MFN pricing were implemented for the top 10 drugs spent on Medicare Part D and Part B in 2025, Medicare
on them would drop from $273B to $76B between 2029 and 2033.

title: Trump set to announce MFN pricing for Medicaid in all states
